rewrite:
def save_as_callback(save_as: Optional[Tuple[ScanExport, Path]]) ->Tuple[
    Optional[str], Optional[Path]]:
    if save_as is None:
        return None, None
    
    export_format, export_path = save_as
    
    if export_format and ScanOutput.is_format(export_format, ScanExport.SPDX):
        raise_if_not_spdx_extension_installed()
    
    return export_format.value if export_format else None, export_path
